name: empty-states-3
title: No Search Results
description: No results found empty state for a filtered search, with a magnifier icon, guidance copy, and a Clear Filters action in a bordered card.

standards.purpose: Turn a blank surface into a next step instead of a dead end.
useWhen: A list, table, or panel has no content to show.
doNotUseWhen: The surface is still loading — show a skeleton instead.

rules.check: The state says why the surface is empty.
Offer one primary next step; secondary links stay subordinate.
Empty, loading, and error states are visually and textually distinct.
